season.title: Season
season.how: Type `season` anywhere on the page, on any page of the site. A picker opens with the four seasons, each a small living landscape in pixel art (a cabin with smoke in winter, a pond with butterflies in spring, a lake under the sunset in summer, a cabin among pumpkins in autumn); pick one with a click or 1 to 4. Its weather (snow, blossom, fireflies or falling leaves) drifts over every page with the scroll, settles on the name, the headlines and the frames, and stays until you reload. Typing `winter`, `spring`, `summer` or `autumn` switches it on straight away, 0 in the picker switches it off. On a phone, tap the last line of the footer five times. It works in the shell too.

mirror.title: Mirror
mirror.how: `mirror` in the shell. Your camera as live ASCII art, mirrored. It only starts after the browser asks. Nothing leaves the tab.

reel.title: Reel
reel.how: `reel` in the shell. Every project clip full screen, with cuts through static. The arrow keys skip.

drop.title: Drop
drop.how: Drag any picture or video onto the page. It turns into characters. It is read locally and never uploaded. Wheel or `+`/`-` changes the resolution, `c` toggles colour.

specimen.title: Specimen
specimen.how: Type `nexor` anywhere, or `fc-list` in the shell. The site's own typeface, as a specimen you can type into.

screensaver.title: Screensaver
screensaver.how: Leave the page alone for 45 seconds.

dotfile.title: Dotfile
dotfile.how: `ls -a` in the shell, then read what you find.

gravity.title: Gravity
gravity.how: Click the name in the footer. The letters fall into the water; click again and they stand back up.

jump.title: Jump
jump.how: Press and hold on empty space. A ring of characters fills around the cursor while the stars are pulled in; when it closes, the page jumps to the next section through hyperspace.

source.title: Source
source.how: Read the code of every project: hover each `code` link in All projects (or `source` in Work).

console.title: Console
console.how: Open the browser console and do what it says.

lightspeed.title: Lightspeed
lightspeed.how: Fling the page: cover two and a half screen heights within half a second.

snake.title: Snake
snake.how: `snake` in the shell. Eat five. Arrows or WASD, swipe on phones, `q` quits.

sculptor.title: Sculptor
sculptor.how: Carve all twelve cuts into the name on the start screen at once: draw quickly back and forth through the letters.

whirl.title: Whirl
whirl.how: On the start screen, circle the name with the cursor three times in a row. It spins once on its axis.

stone.title: Stone
stone.how: Skip a stone across the water under the name in the footer: a fast, flat swipe over a good part of its width.

vim.title: Vim
vim.how: `vim` in the shell. Then get out again.

hello.title: Hello
hello.how: Type `hello` anywhere on the page. The bar at the top says hello back.

wave.title: Wave
wave.how: Type `wave` while the name is on screen. Its 3D letters hop, one after the other.

roll.title: Roll
roll.how: Type `roll` anywhere on the page. The camera does a barrel roll through the world.

lights.title: Lights
lights.how: Type `lights`. The page goes dark and a torch follows the cursor. Type it again, or press esc, and the lights come back.

zen.title: Zen
zen.how: Type `zen`. All the text fades away and only the world is left to scroll through. Type it again, or press esc, to come back.
